_comment: AUDIT §3.4 manual-only perf gate baseline. PLACEHOLDER template: plausible values only, replace on first manual GPU run. Manual local run ONLY (consumer ROCm project, no GPU CI): cargo test --test perf_gate -- --nocapture (CPU parse check); GRIM_GPU_TEST=1 cargo test -p grim-backend-rocm --test perf_gate -- --ignored --nocapture (GPU harness); or cargo bench -p grim-backend-rocm --bench kv_dequant_perf. Fields arch + rocm_version (rocm-profiling-perf minimum: result without arch/version is not reproducible) identify the machine; batch/prefill_decode identify the decode regime. Warmup/GPU-event timing: benches currently use Instant::now() wallclock (docs/benchmarks.md §2); hipEvent timing is the follow-up, not rewritten in this pass.
